title: 2009 AMC 10B Problem 3
statement: Paula the painter had just enough paint for \(30\) identically sized rooms. Unfortunately, on the way to work, three cans of paint fell off her truck, so she had only enough paint for \(25\) rooms. How many cans of paint did she use for the \(25\) rooms?

solutions.text:
The lost \(3\) cans would have painted \(30-25=5\) rooms, so each room takes \(\dfrac35\) of a can.

For \(25\) rooms she used \(\dfrac35\cdot25=15\) cans.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Losing \(3\) cans cost her exactly \(5\) rooms
The paint-per-room rate is \(\dfrac{3}{5}\) of a can
